intro: Every visit brings you one step closer to a reward. Tap your phone on the NFC tag to collect a stamp.

card.title: Stamp card
card.pending_one: {{count}} stamp is waiting for staff approval
card.pending_other: {{count}} stamps are waiting for staff approval

rewards.title: Your rewards
rewards.hint: Show the card code to a staff member to get your reward.

giftCards.title: Gift cards
giftCards.subtitle: A gift card appears here when your stamp card is complete. Show the code or QR to a staff member to get your reward.
giftCards.empty: No gift cards yet. Keep collecting stamps!
giftCards.showHint: Show this code or QR to a staff member. They will verify the card and hand over your reward.

celebrate.title: Congratulations!
celebrate.subtitle: Your card is complete — {{reward}} is yours!
celebrate.subtitleGeneric: Your card is complete — the reward is yours!
celebrate.hint: The gift card has been added to “Gift cards”.

tap.title: Collect a stamp
tap.signInToCollect: Sign in with your phone number to collect the stamp. Your tap is kept for 10 minutes.
tap.pendingHint: The stamp will be added to your card as soon as a staff member approves it.
tap.tryAgain: Tap your phone on the NFC tag again.
tap.retryIn: You can collect your next stamp in {{time}}.
tap.otherBrowser: This link was opened on another device. Tap the NFC tag with your own phone to collect the stamp.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Text messages will also be sent in this language.

devices.title: My devices
devices.subtitle: Devices signed in to your account. Sign out of any device you don't recognise.
devices.signOutOthers: Sign out of all other devices

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Your phone number, name and all your stamps will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.codeHint: Enter the code sent to your phone to confirm.
delete.done: Your account has been deleted. We hope to see you again!
